reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.en: I also just want to still love tennis.
I don't want that feeling of enjoying coming on the court to ever disappear
foreground_english.zh: 不想让上场的快乐消失，

foreground_english.en: and almost have to feel like a chore.
foreground_english.zh: 不想让它变成一份苦差。

review_note: 同一条 LTA 2022 专访：主持人问目标，她说进前一百、打满大满贯之后补的这一句。两档逐词一致（medium 172.14–180.92；small 172.16–180.82，small 多一个 like、kind of，按 medium 写）。镜头 165.16 切入、181.32 切走，段首 171.6 在 slams（170.40）之后，段尾 181.1 让溶解（0.18 秒）停在切点之前。LTA 官网同期稿同句：I also still want to love tennis – I don't want that feeling of enjoying coming on the court to ever disappear。
